purpose: Validation-only inferential analysis, uncertainty estimation, effect sizes, and thesis-ready tables and figures from frozen Phase 1-5 artifacts.

bootstrap.duplicate_cluster_handling: Each sampled cluster occurrence contributes all observations belonging to that cluster.
bootstrap.undefined_replicate_handling: Discard undefined replicates, report valid replicate count, and never impute an undefined metric as zero.

scope.ragtruth_official_test_use: Consolidation of the already frozen supporting evaluator-validation results only; no NLI rerun, search, or recalibration.

research_questions.frozen_wording: How do retrieval strategy and retrieval depth affect whether the retrieved context is sufficient for technical-documentation questions?
research_questions.proposal_intent: How frequently are technical-documentation questions non-answerable because retrieved context is insufficient?
research_questions.operational_mapping: The proposal's question-level answerability intent is evaluated as document retrieval and retrieval-conditioned context sufficiency for the actual context bundle C(q,r,k), not as global question answerability.
datasets: TechQA TRAIN and VALIDATION frozen Phase 2/3 summaries
research_questions.experimental_unit: question_id; repeated retrieval conditions are dependent
research_questions.comparisons: BM25, dense, and hybrid across k in {1,3,5,10}
research_questions.statistical_test: Descriptive consolidation in Phase 6; no new retriever hypothesis family is introduced because TEST remains sealed and the approved Phase 6 request predeclares generation/grounding families A-C.
research_questions.effect_size: Absolute differences are descriptive where shown.
research_questions.confidence_interval: No new aggregate-only interval is fabricated; persisted uncertainty is reported where available.

research_questions.frozen_wording: Which retrieval and context characteristics predict retrieved-context sufficiency, and does a calibrated multivariate classifier improve on always-sufficient, single-score, linear, and uncalibrated tree baselines?
research_questions.proposal_intent: Which retrieval and context characteristics are useful in determining answerability on technical questions?
research_questions.operational_mapping: Prediction targets the frozen retrieval-conditioned y_suff_final and uses only inference-time retrieval/context features.
datasets: TechQA TRAIN for fitting already completed in Phase 4
research_questions.experimental_unit: question_id with all retrieval conditions retained per question
research_questions.comparisons: B1, Logistic Regression, uncalibrated Random Forest, and calibration variants; B0 retained as an operational reference
research_questions.statistical_test: No new post-hoc classifier-family p-value; frozen question-bootstrap confidence intervals and descriptive comparisons are consolidated.
research_questions.effect_size: Metric point differences are descriptive; no post-hoc standardized label is assigned.
research_questions.confidence_interval: Frozen Phase 4 95% question-bootstrap intervals for the selected Random Forest.

research_questions.frozen_wording: How does a calibrated policy that can answer, request additional retrieval evidence, or abstain at k=5-and that resolves expansion cases once at k=10-change unsafe answering, false abstention, retrieval expansion, coverage, and selective risk relative to an always-answer RAG system and simpler gates?
research_questions.proposal_intent: What is the effect of the answerability-aware policy on unsafe answer rate and false abstention rate?
research_questions.operational_mapping: The medium action is one fixed retrieval expansion, and all policy claims are validation-set safety-coverage observations rather than production guarantees.
datasets: TechQA VALIDATION frozen Phase 5 policy views
research_questions.comparisons: Frozen P/G policies and 5%, 10%, and 20% operating points; thresholds are not retuned.
research_questions.statistical_test: No significance test between deterministic operating thresholds; uncertainty for policy proportions uses question bootstrap.
research_questions.effect_size: Absolute policy proportions and safety-coverage trade-offs.
research_questions.confidence_interval: 95% question-bootstrap intervals for coverage, grounded-answer yield, and unsupported-answer population rate.

research_questions.frozen_wording: Does gating reduce exposure to unsupported generated claims, and how reliably does the automatic grounding measure agree with RAGTruth and blinded manual judgement?
research_questions.proposal_intent: How is hallucination risk measured without overclaiming?
research_questions.operational_mapping: Phase 6 tests frozen generation/grounding contrasts while treating NLI support as an imperfect retrieved-context grounding proxy, not authoritative hallucination truth.
datasets: TechQA VALIDATION frozen Phase 5 paired and policy artifacts
RAGTruth official supporting TEST results frozen in Phase 5
research_questions.experimental_unit: TechQA question_id; RAGTruth source_id for already persisted evaluator intervals
research_questions.comparisons: Paired k10-k5; sufficient-insufficient separately at k=5 and k=10; G0-G3 descriptive safety-quality-coverage views.
research_questions.statistical_test: Families A-C: Wilcoxon signed-rank, exact McNemar, Mann-Whitney U, and Fisher exact as predeclared below.
research_questions.effect_size: Mean/median paired difference, matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation, risk difference, Cliff's delta, risk ratio, and odds ratio as applicable.
research_questions.confidence_interval: 95% question-bootstrap intervals for paired differences, association contrasts, Cliff's delta, and policy proportions; frozen source-bootstrap RAGTruth intervals.

hypothesis_families.test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank with Pratt zero handling and aligned complete pairs
hypothesis_families.effect_size: matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation with sign following k10-k5

hypothesis_families.test: two-sided exact McNemar using the discordant-pair binomial distribution

multiple_testing.scope: Applied separately within each predeclared family A, B, and C.

missing_values.continuous_pairs: Use only aligned question pairs with both outcomes observed; report excluded count.
missing_values.binary_pairs: Use only aligned pairs with both binary outcomes observed; never convert NA to false.
missing_values.independent_groups: Exclude only rows missing the named outcome; never zero-impute.
missing_values.policy_quality: Abstentions and undefined answer content remain NA; conditional quality uses answered eligible cases only.
missing_values.undefined_rates: Remain NA when their denominator is zero.

effect_size_conventions.paired_rank_biserial: (sum positive Pratt ranks - sum negative Pratt ranks) / sum nonzero Pratt ranks; positive follows k10-k5.

tiny_sample_guard.interpretation: G2 quality is descriptive only with severe uncertainty; zero observed unsupported responses is not evidence that true risk is zero.

interpretation_rules: A p-value above alpha is described as not providing evidence of a statistically detectable difference, never as proof of no difference.
Context-sufficiency comparisons are associational because the Phase 3 target and generation outcomes are measured on the same retrieval-conditioned state.
The contradictory direction between binary unsupported rate and continuous mean support is retained and discussed.
Observed validation risk is not a production safety guarantee.
Grounding proxy output is not authoritative hallucination truth.
Quality is always reported with coverage for selective policies.
